name: stash-work-plan
description: Resume and coordinate shared component-oriented work through Stash; Git and external connectors are optional.

interface.shortDescription: Resume and coordinate agent work in Stash.
interface.longDescription: Resume a shared project without requiring Git, claim one work item, split child and prerequisite work, link bounded external resources, checkpoint observed results, verify completion evidence, and hand off unfinished tasks.
defaultPrompt: Resume this project's next available Stash work item and continue from its checkpoint.
Resume a Stash work item by ID, verify its evidence, and finish or hand it off.
